players.product: ArF immersion, ArF dry, KrF and i-line semiconductor lithography systems (NSR series), FPD lithography systems and digital lithography systems for advanced packaging

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April 1 - September 30, 2025) consolidated revenue was JPY 312,915 million, down JPY 19,864 million (6.0%), with an operating loss of JPY 4,829 million (prior-year H1: operating profit of JPY 5,817 million); profit attributable to owners of the parent rose 80.7% to JPY 5,356 million on deferred tax assets recognized after the decision to dissolve and liquidate Nikon Metrology NV. Management states growth drivers are progressing steadily but results are below expectations and improving profitability is a challenge.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue JPY 312,915 million (-6.0%); operating loss JPY 4,829 million; profit attributable JPY 5,356 million

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 Precision Equipment segment: revenue JPY 69,886 million (down 14.3%) and operating profit JPY 3,044 million (up 222.6%). FPD lithography product mix improved while unit sales of ArF semiconductor lithography systems fell; profit rose on a gain from transferring the semiconductor wafer bonding technology R&D business and on the effects of the prior year's semiconductor equipment business restructuring.
quarterly_data.figure: Precision Equipment revenue JPY 69,886 million (-14.3%); operating profit JPY 3,044 million (+222.6%)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 other segments: Imaging revenue JPY 145,037 million (down 4.4%), operating profit JPY 15,143 million (down 47.5%); Healthcare revenue JPY 51,218 million (down 7.1%), operating profit JPY 340 million (down 73.8%); Components revenue JPY 35,139 million (up 15.4%), operating profit JPY 5,281 million (up 255.4%), with firm sales of imaging measurement systems for electronic components and semiconductors while EUV-related component sales were hit by the EUV-related market slowdown; Digital Manufacturing revenue JPY 9,826 million (down 16.2%), operating loss JPY 8,963 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Imaging JPY 145,037 million; Healthcare JPY 51,218 million; Components JPY 35,139 million (+15.4%); Digital Manufacturing JPY 9,826 million
